kyoto_minatoya_kosodate_ame.gf_detail: Ask. One hard candy made from malt syrup and sugar; one reviewer read the label as malt sugar from sweet potato and corn, but no gluten information is published (official site; reviews).
kyoto_minatoya_kosodate_ame.vegan_detail: Ask. A candy of malt syrup and granulated sugar, and loose Uji tea; ingredients beyond that are not published (reviews; official site).
kyoto_minatoya_kosodate_ame.hours_raw: 10:00–16:00, every day of the year; open later during Rokudo Mairi (Tabelog); may close for sudden events (official site, January 2026). Takeaway only — a small counter shop with no seating. Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). The small 75 g bag often sells out early; ask the shop to hold one (official site). On Matsubara-dori east of Yamato-oji, at Rokudo no Tsuji, 2 min walk from Rokuharamitsu-ji, 10 min from Keihan Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn (official site).
kyoto_minatoya_kosodate_ame.notes: [Candy shop · Rokuhara, by Rokuharamitsu-ji] A tiny shop that sells one thing: amber malt-syrup candy, broken by hand, tied to a 1599 legend of a dead mother whose ghost came nightly to buy candy for the baby born in the grave. The shop calls itself Japan's oldest candy maker, over 450 years old. A bag is ¥700 (¥400 small), with Uji teas beside it — a gentle sweetness and a story to take home. Open daily 10:00–16:00; cash only.

roles: Family shop, people not named (official site signs as みなとや一同)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: Japan’s longest-established candy shop, over 450 years old; the legend: in Keicho 4 (1599) a wife of the 江村 family was buried, and days later a baby’s cry was heard from the grave — the child of the dead wife; a woman had come every night to buy candy and stopped once the child was dug out; the child became a monk at eight and a renowned priest, dying at 68 in 1666; the candy came to be called the ghost’s child-rearing candy. The shop has supplied its candy to はぐくみハッピーギフト, a Higashiyama ward gift for new parents, and received a letter of thanks (official site, March 2021). Candy and tea are made by hand (official site, September 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: to keep passing on the story of “the candy that carried a life”.

anecdotes.text: An August 2025 first-timer was told by the staff that the ghost first came 426 years ago.
A December 2025 regular notes the legend is said to have inspired GeGeGe no Kitaro.
A September 2025 visitor bought a bag as a gift for a couple expecting a baby.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kosodateame.com): みなとや幽霊子育飴本舗、500年以上続く日本一歴史ある飴屋 (由来のページでは450年以上)、命をつないだ飴の由来 (慶長四年、江村氏の妻を葬った後、土中から幼児の泣き声、夜な夜な飴を買いに来た婦人、その子は八才で僧となり高名な僧に、寛文六年に六十八歳で遷化)、店頭販売は幽霊子育飴と宇治茶、2026年10月1日から子育飴150g 700円・75g 400円、宇治茶 (玉露40g、煎茶70g、ほうじ茶150g、抹茶20g) 一律800円、75gは早い時間に品切れの場合あり・取り置き可、手づくりで製造・販売、年中無休 10:00〜16:00、急な予定で休業あり、東山区松原通大和大路東入2丁目轆轤町80番地の1、六波羅蜜寺から徒歩2分、清水五条駅から徒歩10分、東山区の「はぐくみハッピーギフト」に子育飴、感謝状 (2021年)。食べログ: 和菓子、10:00〜16:00、六道まいりの期間は延長、年中無休、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、禁煙、テイクアウト。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 琥珀色の硬い飴、麦芽水飴の素朴な甘さ、水飴とグラニュー糖だけ、試食あり、ゲゲゲの鬼太郎のもとになったという話、六道の辻、宇治茶も販売。

existence.note: Official site with a price notice dated 25 September 2026; reviews dated through July 2026.

kyoto_sake_to_shun_goro.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: tempura is a house specialty; soy-seasoned izakaya dishes (2026 reviews).
kyoto_sake_to_shun_goro.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish restaurant — sashimi, grilled fish and shellfish, chawanmushi (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_sake_to_shun_goro.hours_raw: Tue–Sun 18:00–24:00; closed Monday (Tabelog). Bookings taken, and reviewers say they are a must; a July 2026 first-timer saw a line of booked guests before opening (Tabelog; February and July 2026 reviews). Table charge: Tabelog's Japanese original says 「お通し代あり、たぶん500円」 — an otoshi charge, "probably ¥500"; one reviewer's otoshi was a fish head, another's included nigiri (December 2025, March 2026). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 20 seats: a long counter of 10 and 10 at tables; smoking allowed (Tabelog; July 2026 review). JIN四条大宮 1F, in an alley 4 min from Hankyu Omiya Stn (Tabelog; May 2026 reviews).
kyoto_sake_to_shun_goro.notes: [Fish & sake izakaya · Shijo-Omiya] A busy alley izakaya opened in 2023, loved by regulars for very fresh fish: a 12-kind sashimi platter (order it when you book), grilled sweet shrimp, a loaded chawanmushi and tempura one piece at a time, with chosen sake. About ¥5,000–8,000. Book ahead; smoking allowed.

chef_bio.specialty: Sashimi platter; seasonal fish with sake.

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 regular booked the 12-kind sashimi platter for two friends, who were left speechless when it arrived.
In March 2026 a regular hoped to have tempura, but it was not on the menu that night.
A July 2026 first-timer saw booked guests lining up before opening; the food came out slowly, timed to each course.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 酒と旬 五郎、天ぷら・居酒屋・そば、中京区七軒町462 JIN四条大宮 1F、阪急大宮駅から徒歩4分、火〜日 18:00〜24:00、月曜休み、予約可、お通し代あり (たぶん500円)、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、20席 (カウンター10、テーブル10)、喫煙可、魚にこだわる、日本酒にこだわる、2023年2月26日オープン。口コミ (2025年12月〜2026年10月、英語): 予約必須、12種の刺身の盛り合わせ (要予約)、本まぐろ・甘えび・いかのウニ和えの海苔巻き、甘えびの塩焼き、焼き牡蠣、金目鯛のかま焼き、蟹味噌・ウニ・いくら・白子・牡蠣の茶碗蒸し、一つずつ揚げる天ぷら、手書きのメニュー、長いカウンター、開店前に予約客の列。

cultural_comfort.note: Handwritten Japanese menu; book ahead; smoking allowed.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_gihan_hajimedo_tower_sando.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: gyoza, ramen and tantanmen, fried chicken with soy-based sauces (2026 reviews).
kyoto_gihan_hajimedo_tower_sando.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fried chicken, chashu, shrimp and egg fried rice, meat gyoza (2026 reviews).
kyoto_gihan_hajimedo_tower_sando.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–23:00; irregular closures (Tabelog). No bookings (Tabelog). A counter in the Kyoto Tower Sando food court, B1F: pay at the register or order by mobile from your table, then wait for the buzzer; shared food-court seating (9 seats listed) (Tabelog; July–November 2026 reviews). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). 2 min from Kyoto Stn central exit (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_gihan_hajimedo_tower_sando.notes: [Chinese food-court counter · Kyoto Tower Sando] A quick Chinese counter under Kyoto Tower from the group behind 創作中華 一之船入 and 魏飯夷堂: big yurinchi fried chicken, tantanmen and fried-rice sets, gyoza and beer, mostly ¥1,000–1,500. Order at the counter or on your phone, then find a food-court seat. Open daily till 23:00.

roles: Food-court counter of the 一之船入 group; menu supervised by the group's chef
chef_bio.background: Opened 14 April 2017 (Tabelog). The Tabelog shop text calls it the sister restaurant of 魏飯夷堂, opened in the Kyoto Tower Sando food court, with dishes supervised by Chef Wei Xizhi (Tabelog English); an August 2026 regular credits the chefs of 一之船入. A November 2026 diner noted the kitchen staff seemed to be from outside China.
chef_bio.philosophy: Authentic Chinese with fine ingredients, made easy to try (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 regular orders the five-ingredient fried rice here with grilled gyoza from a neighbouring counter, calling it the best fried rice ever.
A July 2026 diner came after trying the gyoza at the Sanjo sister shop.
An October 2026 diner found the five-flavor fried rice bland and the draft beer poor, among mostly overseas guests.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 魏飯吉堂 京都タワーサンド店、中華料理・台湾料理、下京区烏丸通七条下ル東塩小路町721-1 KYOTO TOWER SANDO B1F、毎日 11:00〜23:00、不定休、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、9席、禁煙、2017年4月14日オープン、魏飯夷堂の姉妹店として京都タワーサンドのフードコートに開店、魏禧之シェフの監修。口コミ (2026年7〜11月、英語): 一之船入のシェフたちによる気軽な中華、五目炒飯とスープ818円、揚州炒飯、油淋鶏1,000円とそのセット、ニンニク醤油の唐揚げのセット1,500円、担々麺のセット、チャーシュー麺と餃子のセット約1,500円、餃子2人前1,500円、ちょい飲みセット、レジで支払いブザーで受け取り、テーブルからモバイル注文、三条の姉妹店、海外の客が多い、炒飯の味が薄いという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Food-court counter with picture menu and mobile ordering.

existence.note: Tabelog listing kept by the operator; reviews dated through November 2026.

kyoto_shinshindo_kyodai_kitamonmae.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a bakery café — rolls, sandwiches, toast, cream puffs and curry (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_shinshindo_kyodai_kitamonmae.vegan_detail: Not vegan: egg sandwiches, meat curry, cakes and coffee with milk (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_shinshindo_kyodai_kitamonmae.hours_raw: Mon and Wed–Sun 10:00–18:00 (last order 17:30); closed Tuesday (Tabelog). rurubu also lists 10:00–18:00, closed Tuesday. Order at the counter, then sit (May 2026 review). No bookings; cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). No photos inside: signs on the door and in the room (Tabelog; November 2025–August 2026 reviews). 100 seats at long wooden tables, with tables kept for students and a student discount on coffee with a university ID (November 2025 and February 2026 reviews; a May 2026 diner was told the discount needs the whole party to be university students). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Facing Kyoto University's north gate; 10 min from Demachiyanagi Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_shinshindo_kyodai_kitamonmae.notes: [1930 student café · Kyoto University north gate] Kyoto's "second university library": a Paris-inspired café opened in 1930, with massive wooden tables by the craftsman Kuroda Tatsuaki, a courtyard, and students reading over a single blend coffee, curry or a sandwich. About ¥1,000. Cash only; no photos inside; closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened in 1930 as a French-style café by the bakery 進々堂, which began in 1913 and was the first in Kyoto to sell French bread; the founder, 続木斉, had studied bread-making in Paris and modelled the café on those in the Latin Quarter, hoping Japanese students would also learn Western esprit (serai.jp). The long one-piece tables and benches were commissioned from the woodworker 黒田辰秋 so many students could sit at once (serai.jp; rurubu; November 2025 review). The fourth-generation proprietor 川口聡 says the café's atmosphere stays the same because of the founding ideals (serai.jp, undated). Operator: rurubu says the café is now a separate corporation from the 進々堂 bakery, and the bakery's own shop list does not include it; 2026 reviewers still call it a branch of the Kyoto bakery chain (May and September 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: "The air of the shop stays the same even as the times and the town change, because of the founding ideals" (川口聡, serai.jp).
chef_bio.specialty: Blend coffee; curry rice set; sandwiches.

anecdotes.text: In October 2025 a visitor returned after about 50 years, reading a maths and physics book bought at a nearby bookshop over black coffee.
A November 2025 visitor on the way to Ginkaku-ji found the sandwiches sold out, took the roll-bread brunch set, and found the staff's indifference very Kyoto.
A November 2025 visitor was told that lingering was not allowed before noon, and felt the many notices spoiled the calm.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 進々堂 京大北門前、カフェ・パン・サンドイッチ、左京区北白川追分町88、出町柳駅から徒歩10分、月・水〜日 10:00〜18:00 (L.O. 17:30)、火曜休み、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、100席、禁煙、テイクアウト可、店内撮影禁止の掲示。るるぶ: 京都発祥のベーカリー「進々堂」が昭和5年 (1930) に開いたカフェ、現在はベーカリー進々堂とは別法人、「京大第二の図書室」、パリのカフェを手本にした店構え、黒田辰秋の机、ミックスサンドイッチ、カレーライスセット、ブレンドコーヒー。serai.jp: 大正2年にパン屋として始まり京都で初めてフランスパンを提供、昭和5年にフランス風カフェを開店、創業者・続木斉がパリのカルチエ・ラタンのカフェを手本に、黒田辰秋の一枚板の大机と長椅子、4代目の川口聡さん、ブレンド一本のコーヒー、フランスパンとフレンチロール、バタートースト、ハムトースト、自家製カレーライスセット。口コミ (2025年10月〜2026年9月、英語): 角砂糖のコーヒー、シュークリームのケーキセット、ロールパンのブランチセット、卵サンド、カレーライスセット950円、パンケーキ、学生用の勉強席、学生証で割引、中庭、注文してから席へ、京都のベーカリーの支店とする声。

cultural_comfort.note: Order at the counter; cash only; no photos inside.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_italian_quatro_ekimae.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: fresh pasta, pizza, gnocchi gratin and cheese tortillas (2026 reviews).
kyoto_italian_quatro_ekimae.vegan_detail: Ask. Arrabbiata and salads are on the menu, but most dishes have cheese, ham or seafood (2026 reviews).
kyoto_italian_quatro_ekimae.hours_raw: Daily 11:30–14:30 (last order 14:00) and 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:30); irregular closures (Tabelog). Bookings taken, lunch included, even on Sundays; fully booked on a holiday lunch (Tabelog; September and October 2026 reviews). Charge: Tabelog's Japanese original says 「アミューズ料金として380円を頂戴いたします。」 — a ¥380 amuse charge. Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), e-money and QR (Tabelog). 75 seats with counter, sofas and semi-private tables; private rooms for 2 or 4; non-smoking; children and strollers welcome (Tabelog). Order by QR code (November 2026 review). Shin-Kyoto Center Bldg 1F, 5 min from Kyoto Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_italian_quatro_ekimae.notes: [Italian bar · Kyoto Station] A roomy, relaxed Italian a few minutes from Kyoto Station that takes lunch bookings: fresh pasta, paella, pizza and a big antipasti plate, with lunch sets from about ¥1,000 and dinner around ¥4,000–5,000 with an all-you-can-drink option. ¥380 amuse charge.

roles: Restaurant of バル・コーポレーション (Kyoto) (no person named)
chef_bio.background: Opened 23 August 2010 (Tabelog). Run by 株式会社バル・コーポレーション of Nakagyo-ku, which lists five restaurants: 輝庭, 源輝家, ITALIAN QUATRO 四条烏丸店 and 京都駅前店, and 蔵 寺町店 (bal-flower.co.jp).

anecdotes.text: Two friends ate antipasti, pasta and dessert in August 2026 before an evening bus tour from Kyoto.
An October 2026 diner booked a Sunday lunch, though the pre-ordered "Quattro Lunch" message did not get through; a friend found the carbonara salty.
In November 2026 a diner saw groups of nearly 20 and many overseas guests.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): ITALIAN QUATRO 京都駅前店、イタリアン・ワインバー・ステーキ、下京区塩小路通烏丸西入東塩小路町614 新京都センタービル1F、JR京都駅から徒歩5分、毎日 11:30〜14:30 (L.O. 14:00)・17:00〜22:00 (L.O. 21:30)、不定休、予約可、アミューズ料金380円、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、75席、2名・4名の個室、禁煙、子ども可、2010年8月23日オープン。バル・コーポレーション (京都市中京区) の公式サイト: 輝庭、源輝家、イタリアン クアトロ 四条烏丸店・京都駅前店、蔵 寺町店。口コミ (2026年8〜11月、英語): 生パスタ (雪のパルメザンのカルボナーラ、しらす、アラビアータ、タコのプッタネスカ、クルミとモッツァレラのカチョエペペ)、パエリア、肉料理、ディアボラのピザ、マルゲリータ、ニョッキのグラタン、ローストビーフのシーザーサラダ、前菜の盛り合わせ、クアトロランチ2,288円から、ランチ約1,000円から、ソフトドリンク300円、飲み放題、QR コードで注文、海外の客が多い。

existence.note: Tabelog listing kept by the restaurant; reviews dated through November 2026.

kyoto_mement_mori_okazaki.gf_detail: Ask. A daily plate of small Japanese and Western dishes with rice, and cakes (2023–26 reviews); no gluten information.
kyoto_mement_mori_okazaki.vegan_detail: Ask. The plate changes daily and has included pork and fish-sauce dishes (July 2023); no vegan information.
kyoto_mement_mori_okazaki.hours_raw: Fri–Sun 11:30–18:00; closed Monday–Thursday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog); the daily plate is limited — 15 servings in September 2024 — and ends when sold out (Tabelog). CASH ONLY — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog; April 2025). 8 seats: 4 at the counter, 4 at a table (Tabelog). Run by one person (May 2024; March 2026). Non-smoking (Tabelog). By the canal on the ground floor of M&M’s apartment, Okazaki; 3 min from the Okazaki Park bus stops, 11 min from Higashiyama Stn (Tabelog). Opened 14 May 2011 (Tabelog).
kyoto_mement_mori_okazaki.notes: [Café · Okazaki canal, a one-person weekend lunch plate] An eight-seat café by the Okazaki canal, open only Friday to Sunday, where one person cooks a gentle daily plate of small Japanese and Western dishes (about ¥1,500, limited and often sold out), with coffee and cake. Cherry blossom fills the window in spring. Cash only — come early or book.

roles: Owner (unnamed), who runs the café alone (May 2024; March 2026)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a café opened 14 May 2011, now open Friday to Sunday. Reviews from May 2024 and March 2026 describe one person running it.

anecdotes.text: An April 2025 visitor found the cherry blossom view over the canal stunning but had to give up the rice plate for lack of cash.
A September 2024 group arrived at 11:45 and booked a table for 13:30 to get the limited plate.
A May 2024 first-timer, after pandemic-era irregular hours, found the gentle food and kind solo service worth the wait.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: カフェ・ケーキ、左京区岡崎西天王町84-1 M&M’s apartment 1F、東山駅から徒歩11分、岡崎公園のバス停から3分、金土日11:30〜18:00、月〜木休み、予約可、現金のみ、8席 (カウンター4、テーブル4)、禁煙、2011年5月14日オープン、本日のプレート1,500円 (なくなり次第終了)。口コミ (2023年7月〜2026年7月、英語): 和洋の小さなおかずのワンプレート、15食限定1,650円、豚の冷しゃぶのポン酢、お揚げの料理、食後のコーヒー250円、疏水沿いの窓から桜、一人で営む、週末のみ。

cultural_comfort.note: Book or come early for the limited plate; cash only; small and quiet. No English evidence found.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through July 2026.

kyoto_hatoya_shokudo.gf_detail: Ask. Home-style side dishes, soups and udon or Chinese-noodle sets (2025–26 reviews); no gluten information.
kyoto_hatoya_shokudo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork miso soup, sake-lees soup, mackerel and meat udon (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_hatoya_shokudo.hours_raw: 6:00–18:00; closed Saturday (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). CASH ONLY — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 18 seats at 9 small tables (Tabelog). A smoking area, with no smoking 12:00–13:00; a posted sign says children are not allowed inside (Tabelog). Order a soup or noodles, then pick 2–3 sides from the trays by the owner (February 2026). On the corner of Higashioji and Marutamachi facing Kumano Shrine; 558 m from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog; December 2025). In business over 70 years according to information online (December 2025).
kyoto_hatoya_shokudo.notes: [Diner · Higashioji Marutamachi, home cooking from 6 am] A long-running diner facing Kumano Shrine, open from dawn: order a pork miso soup, sake-lees soup or udon, then pick a couple of home-style sides — grilled mackerel, chilled tofu, rolled egg — from the trays, for under ¥1,000. Cash only; no children; closed Saturday.

roles: Owner (unnamed), who serves from the side-dish trays (February 2026)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a cafeteria-style diner at the Higashioji Marutamachi crossing. A December 2025 reviewer read online that it has been in business for over 70 years.
chef_bio.specialty: Pork miso soup set; pick-your-own sides.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 morning jogger stopped for a kitsune udon set with simmered mackerel, ¥900 in all.
A November 2025 visitor hunting for an early-opening breakfast found it and parked behind Kumano Shrine.
An October 2026 visitor noted how hard it is to find ordinary home cooking out, and why regulars might come daily.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 食堂、左京区聖護院山王町43-1、神宮丸太町駅から558m、6:00〜18:00、土曜休み、予約不可、現金のみ、18席、分煙 (12〜13時は禁煙)、子供の入店不可の貼り紙。口コミ (2025年6月〜2026年10月、英語): 熊野神社前の東大路丸太町の角、汁物や麺を頼み、店主の近くのトレーから小鉢を2〜3品選ぶ、豚汁定食 (鯖の塩焼き、冷奴)、粕汁定食、きつねうどん定食 (鯖の煮付け、900円)、肉うどん定食、中華そば定食、卵焼き、70年以上続く店 (ネットの情報、2025年12月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Order a soup or noodles and point to the side dishes you want; cash only; no children. No English evidence found.

kyoto_nagamegawa_pontocho.gf_detail: Ask. Kaiseki with tempura, sukiyaki, saikyo-miso fish and yudofu (2026 reviews); no gluten information.
kyoto_nagamegawa_pontocho.vegan_detail: Not vegan: kaiseki with sashimi, hamo, Omi beef sukiyaki and dashi; tofu and yuba are part of mixed courses (2026 reviews).
kyoto_nagamegawa_pontocho.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–14:30 (last order 13:30), dinner 17:00–22:00 (last order 20:30), daily (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; guests with preschool children are seated only in private rooms, if one is free (Tabelog). The kawadoko (river terrace) moves indoors if rain is likely, and wet terrace or kotatsu-terrace seats move indoors (Tabelog); terrace seating ran to the end of October in 2026 (October 2026). Service charge 10% (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「サービス料10％」). Cards incl. UnionPay; QR incl. Alipay and WeChat Pay; no e-money (Tabelog). 60 seats; non-smoking (Tabelog). The eighth house on the east side of Pontocho north of Shijo; 2 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog). No children’s menu (September 2026).
kyoto_nagamegawa_pontocho.notes: [Kyoto cuisine · Pontocho, kaiseki on the river terrace] A Pontocho house with a kawadoko over the Kamo River that stays open to the end of October: a ¥4,840 mini kaiseki with Omi beef sukiyaki at lunch, summer kaiseki (¥6,600) with yuba, hamo and yudofu, or indoor seats with a river view. 10% service. Preschool children only in private rooms; no kids menu.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a Japanese, tofu and sukiyaki restaurant on Pontocho with river-terrace and kotatsu-terrace seating.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 diner was glad the terrace was still open at month’s end, when neighbours had closed theirs by mid-October.
An October 2026 overseas visitor was glad a first taste of Kyoto cuisine came here, and the friends all loved it.
A September 2026 parent noted there is no children’s menu, calling the terrace kaiseki a place for adults.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日本料理・豆腐料理・すき焼き、中京区先斗町通四条上ル東側8軒目鍋屋町232-10、京都河原町駅から徒歩2分、昼12:00〜14:30 (L.O. 13:30)、夜17:00〜22:00 (L.O. 20:30)、予約可、未就学児は個室のみ、雨の予報で納涼床は店内に、サービス料10%、カード・QR 可、60席、禁煙。口コミ (2026年6月〜10月、英語): Omi の牛のすき焼きと鰆の西京焼きのミニ懐石4,840円、天ぷらの昼のセット約4,000円、生湯葉と鱧と鮪の刺身、鱧の天ぷら鍋、夏の懐石6,600円 (先付、刺身、西京焼き、湯豆腐、揚げ物、ちりめんご飯、味噌汁、デザート)、川床の懐石、10月末まで床あり、子供のメニューはない。

cultural_comfort.note: Book a kaiseki course and request the river terrace in season; 10% service. No English evidence found.

kyoto_tairiki_tei_nanzenji.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: homemade wheat udon and tempura (official site; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_tairiki_tei_nanzenji.vegan_detail: Not vegan: udon in dashi with chicken and burdock tempura (2026 reviews).
kyoto_tairiki_tei_nanzenji.hours_raw: 11:30–20:00, open all year (Tabelog). Dinner reservations are for courses only (official site); at lunch, expect a queue from before opening with numbered tickets (October–November 2026). Cancellation on the day costs 100%, and switching from a course to à la carte after arriving is charged at the course price (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 47 seats: counters facing the garden, tables, private room (Tabelog; October 2026). Non-smoking; smoking area outside (Tabelog). 1 min from the main gate of Nanzen-ji; 9 min from Keage Stn (Tabelog). First anniversary celebrated in January 2025 (official site).
kyoto_tairiki_tei_nanzenji.notes: [Udon and café · Nanzen-ji, a garden view with lunch] A restaurant a minute from Nanzen-ji’s gate whose counters look out on a Japanese garden: homemade udon with Awa-chicken or burdock tempura (¥1,600–1,700), dango you toast yourself and matcha latte. Very popular — a numbered queue forms before 11:30. Dinner is courses only, by reservation. Open daily.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: a restaurant with a seasonal Japanese garden view and homemade udon, which marked its first anniversary in January 2025 with maiko dances; dinner reservations are for courses only. An October 2026 reviewer says the garden was designed by an 11th-generation gardener of the Ogawa line.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 visitor arrived at 11:00 and saw a queue form quickly; only courses could be booked.
A September 2026 café visitor enjoyed toasting dango at the table with a choice of toppings.
A November 2026 visitor arriving five minutes before opening was the 15th group in line.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 四季折々の絶景の庭園、職人の自家製うどん、ディナーの予約はコースのみ、2025年1月に開店1周年の舞妓の舞。食べログ: うどん・ステーキ・カフェ、左京区南禅寺草川町81、南禅寺の正門から徒歩1分、蹴上駅から徒歩9分、11:30〜20:00、無休、予約可 (当日キャンセル100%、来店後のコースからの変更もコース料金)、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、47席、禁煙 (外に喫煙所)。口コミ (2026年9月〜11月、英語): Awa の鶏と舞茸の天ぷらうどん1,700円、大きなごぼう天うどん1,600円、自分で焼く団子、抹茶ラテ、庭に面したカウンター、開店前から整理券の行列。

cultural_comfort.note: Queue for a numbered ticket at lunch; dinner is courses by reservation. Many overseas visitors (November 2026). No English evidence found.
